title: Justice Album Cover
coreRelationships: The large, fragmented typography is centrally placed and partially obscures the subject, creating a sense of tension and visual obstruction.
The subject's pensive pose and the dark, textured background establish a somber and introspective mood.
The neon-teal color of the main typography strongly contrasts with the dark, muted greens and blues of the background and subject, making it pop.
The distressed textures and glitch-like fragmentation of the typography reinforce an edgy, urban aesthetic.
reuseFormula: Recreate the composition with a pensive male figure in a dark, textured tunnel, applying a distressed filter. Overlay a large, neon-teal, heavily fragmented, bold sans-serif title, and a small, white, widely-tracked, all-caps sans-serif metadata text at the bottom.
